records.issue_text: Group creation ignores params[:alias_level], so non-default alias levels sent by the client are silently replaced with the default
records.rationale: Looking at the create method in app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb, the diff shows: group.name = (params[:name] || '').strip and group.visible = params[:visible] == 'true', but there is no line setting group.alias_level from params[:alias_level]. records.issue_text: After deleting the only member on the last page, findMembers() reuses an out-of-range offset and leaves the UI on a blank page instead of returning to the last populated page
records.rationale: Looking at the diff, when removeMember is called, it calls self.findMembers() after deletion. In findMembers(), the offset is calculated as Math.min(this.get('user_count'), Math.max(this.get('offset'), 0)).
